name: Titus Billings
role: Caretaker of the Morley farm and later bishop’s counselor
dateNote: He was baptized on 15 November 1830, and section 63 told him in August 1831 to sell the farm and move to Zion.
importance: Section 63 says he “has the care” of the Kirtland farm where many Saints lived. It tells him to dispose of the land and lead its residents to Missouri the next spring. He was ordained an elder in March 1832 while on the way to Jackson County. He later served as a counselor to Bishop Edward Partridge in Missouri and Illinois.
connections: Husband of Diantha Morley, the younger sister of Isaac Morley, whose farm he managed. He worked under Bishop Edward Partridge.
reviewNote: Birth, baptism, ordinations, marriage, and counselor role checked on JSP; death (6 February 1866, Provo) confirmed on Wikipedia, which also gives the sister relationship.
